byMutation.bug: The approve button names an amount, but the dApp requests an unlimited approval.
The approval goes to an address that isn't the protocol's contract.
The transaction sends ten times the ETH the user typed.
A plain sign-in message is swapped for an unlimited token permit to a stranger.
The dApp never hears that the user switched accounts, so it keeps acting for the old one.
When the user rejects in the wallet, the dApp's promise never settles, so it waits forever.
The dApp's network switch silently does nothing, then it sends on the wrong chain.

issues.title: The page doesn't explain what happened after reject
issues.label: true
issues.note: After a 4001 rejection Lido shows 'Transaction Failed / Something went wrong' with Retry, so a deliberate cancel reads like a failure. Minor UX, but accurate.

issues.title: The page doesn't explain what happened after wrong network
issues.label: false
issues.note: Engine bug. Lido did switch to Ethereum; DappDrill then rejected the stake itself because the recorded selector 0xa1903eab didn't string-match the decoded name 'submit'. Fixed: matchesFunction.
issues.fixed: Selector expectations: replay now matches a recorded 4-byte selector against the calldata (core matchesFunction).

issues.title: The page doesn't explain what happened after switch account
issues.label: false
issues.note: Engine bug, same cause: Lido sent from the new account B and DappDrill rejected the request over the selector/name mismatch.
issues.fixed: Selector expectations: replay now matches a recorded 4-byte selector against the calldata (core matchesFunction).

issues.title: No message when there isn't enough ETH for gas
issues.label: false
issues.note: Lido shows 'Entered ETH amount exceeds your available balance' under the field; the feedback detector didn't know that phrasing. Fixed: feedbackMessage.
issues.fixed: The feedback detector now reads "exceeds your available balance" as a message.

issues.title: Flow breaks when the RPC is slow
issues.label: false
issues.note: Engine bug: 'expected a call to 0xa1903eab, the dApp calls submit' is the same call. Not a slow-RPC failure.
issues.fixed: Selector expectations: replay now matches a recorded 4-byte selector against the calldata (core matchesFunction).

issues.title: Doesn't match the flow's expectation: Stake ETH 0.05 ETH on AppProxyUpgradeable
issues.label: false
issues.note: Engine bug: the signing review's expectation check compared the selector with the name. The stake is correct (ui-match passed with high confidence).
issues.fixed: Selector expectations: replay now matches a recorded 4-byte selector against the calldata (core matchesFunction).

replayIssues.title: Rejecting 'Unlock tokens and wrap' leaves the button stuck on 'Unlock tokens and wrap'
replayIssues.label: false
replayIssues.note: The replay account has no stETH (the scan staked first), so after the rejection the page shows "Entered stETH amount exceeds your available balance of 0" and disables the button for that reason. It isn't stuck.
replayIssues.fixed: A disabled button next to a feedback message is no longer called stuck (inspectRecovery).

replayIssues.title: No message after rejecting 'Stake'
replayIssues.label: false
replayIssues.note: Lido's backend began answering "Sorry, access is currently unavailable" (HTTP 429) after many replays, so Stake never sent a transaction and nothing was rejected. The page did show a message.
replayIssues.fixed: The reject checks now run only after a request was actually rejected, and "unavailable" counts as feedback (replay/edge-cases.ts recoveryChecks, test in edge-cases.test.ts).

issues.title: With two wallets installed, the dApp talks to Rabby instead of MetaMask
issues.label: true
issues.note: The user picked MetaMask in the EIP-6963 list but Compound sent requests through window.ethereum, which the second wallet owns. Same as a real Rabby + MetaMask setup.

issues.title: Flow breaks when the RPC is slow
issues.label: false
issues.note: Engine bug: recorded selector 0xf2b9fdb8 compared to the decoded name 'supply'. Fixed by matchesFunction.
issues.fixed: Selector expectations: replay now matches a recorded 4-byte selector against the calldata (core matchesFunction).
